items.title: Audio reveals exchanges between control centre and drivers before deadly Spain train crash
items.description: The recordings appear to show one high-speed train was given clearance to move even though another up ahead had stalled.

items.title: Flávio Bolsonaro denies fleeing Brazil after landing in Miami
items.description: The defeated Brazilian candidate claims to be the victim of a coup d’état and political persecution, recycling unsubstantiated allegations of “electoral fraud”.

items.title: Netanyahu's bloc leading Israel election but short of majority, partial results show
items.description: With 85% of ballots counted, Netanyahu's Likud party and its allies are set to win 53 seats in the 120-seat Knesset.

items.title: Elon Musk is a 'real genius', Putin says after satellite talks with SpaceX boss
items.description: The Russian President praised Musk and said they are in "close" contact.

items.title: Building boom puts 300,000 people in the path of potential Himalayan disasters
items.description: The construction of tourism facilities, housing, and infrastructure has surged in parts of Nepal and India's Uttarakhand.

items.title: Details of thousands of US immigration agents leaked in major hack
items.description: A group called the Department of Peace released information on more than 41,000 DHS staff.

items.title: Death of US actress Hayden Panettiere ruled accidental, ending local police probe
items.description: The Heroes and Nashville star died in August from the toxic effects of fentanyl, Xanax and several other drugs.

items.title: El Salvador sends 2,000 troops to Haiti to rescue four missing soldiers
items.description: The troops are trying to recover four military personnel who went missing in an ambush on the outskirts of the Haitian capital Port-au-Prince.

items.title: Ethiopia acquires Russian fighter jets and air defence systems amid war in Tigray
items.description: The acquisition of the warplanes comes amid ongoing fighting in northern Tigray region that started last month.

items.title: Girl seriously injured in wolf attack at German wildlife park
items.description: The eight-year-old was in an enclosure with other children and a staff member when she was attacked.

items.title: 'Like cutting up a Picasso': AI microdrama edit of Neighbours worries actors and crew
items.description: A micro-drama will use AI-assisted technology to edit old episodes of the Australian TV soap to focus on Margot Robbie's character.

items.title: Hello Kitty maker cuts ties with Japanese spy drama after China backlash
items.description: Sanrio has apologised after its merchandise line with Japanese TV series Vivant drew criticism.

items.title: Luxury cruise passengers stranded in Cambodia due to soaring fuel costs
items.description: The Villa Vie Odyssey suspended its voyage and is working with passengers on "temporary living arrangements".

items.title: Serbian shot dead after attacking officer outside Israeli embassy, minister says
items.description: Authorities say the attacker in Belgrade was an underage male who was being monitored by security services.

items.title: Tanzania celebrates first natural gas discovery in more than 10 years
items.description: The energy minister described it as a "major milestone" for the East African nation.

items.title: Anger in Kenya over extradition hearing delay for ex-British soldier accused of murdering woman
items.description: No official reason has been given for postponing next month’s hearing to May 2027, the family says.

items.title: Ceasefire extended across Ukraine's Kherson region, officials say
items.description: The truce was originally planned for the stranded residents of Oleshky, and Russia and Ukraine say no breaches have been reported.

items.title: Watch: King dances in the streets of the Bahamas capital
items.description: The monarch is in the Bahamas as part of a tour of the Caribbean during which he addressed the "great suffering of the past".

items.title: Watch: At the scene of Spain's deadly train crash
items.description: People have been killed after a Spanish high-speed train collided with another train south of the capital Madrid, making this the country's worst disaster since 2013.

items.title: Israel's election result is messy - here's why
items.description: Despite having the highest voter turnout in nearly three decades, Israel's elections have had no clear winner. What does this mean for the country, asks the BBC's Yolande Knell.
